title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: From the historic stacks of Bertrand Library to the modern, light-filled atriums of Academic West and Holmes Hall, Bucknell offers a diverse range of environments for deep focus and collaboration.

cards.title: East Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Bertrand Library, Level 2
cards.notes: Find long open tables and large windows in this quiet, traditional library space. It is ideal for spreading out textbooks and deep focus sessions.
cards.short_summary: A traditional, quiet study hall on the second floor of Bertrand Library featuring large tables and natural light.
cards.evidence_claim: The East Reading Room on Level 2 of Bertrand Library features long open tables and is noted as a quiet space for study.
cards.access_notes: Open to students during library hours; some carrels are reserved for graduate students and senior thesis writers.

cards.title: Academic West Atrium
cards.subtitle: Academic West Building
cards.notes: Study in a LEED Platinum-certified building featuring modern gathering spaces and collaborative project rooms with a green roof view.
cards.short_summary: A modern, eco-friendly academic building with flexible project rooms and open collaborative gathering spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Academic West features 70,000 square feet of classrooms, labs, and gathering spaces designed for student-faculty collaboration.
cards.access_notes: Accessible to students during building operating hours; features 10 flexible project/conference rooms.

cards.title: Willard Smith Library
cards.subtitle: Vaughan Literature Building
cards.notes: Experience a prototypical library atmosphere with historic charm and wood-paneled surroundings. Perfect for quiet reading and group collaboration.
cards.short_summary: A historic, wood-paneled library within the Vaughan Literature Building used for classes and quiet study.
cards.evidence_claim: The Willard Smith Library in the Vaughan Literature Building is described as a historic library space perfect for reading and group collaboration.
cards.access_notes: Open to all undergraduate students for reading and small group work.

cards.title: Rooke Science Greenhouse
cards.subtitle: Rooke Science Center
cards.notes: Study surrounded by refreshing greenery and natural light. This unique spot offers a serene vantage point and a chill atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: A plant-filled greenhouse within the science center providing a bright and tranquil environment for studying.
cards.evidence_claim: The Rooke Science Greenhouse is cited by students as a beautiful study spot with refreshing greenery and a serene atmosphere.
cards.source_title: Bucknell's best study spots - The Bucknellian
cards.access_notes: Located within the Rooke Science Center; accessible during building hours.

cards.title: Holmes Hall Atrium
cards.subtitle: Holmes Hall
cards.notes: Collaborate in this colorful, light-filled atrium. The building features large windows and flexible, technology-ready spaces for management and art students.
cards.short_summary: A bright, modern atrium in Holmes Hall designed for collaboration between management and art students.
cards.evidence_claim: Holmes Hall features a light-filled atrium and flexible, technology-ready spaces for student collaboration.
cards.access_notes: Open to students; features open tables in halls and meeting rooms.

cards.title: ELC Top Floor
cards.subtitle: Elaine Langone Center
cards.notes: Join a focused community of students on the top floor of the student center. It is conveniently located near campus dining for quick snack breaks.
cards.short_summary: A popular, high-productivity study area on the uppermost level of the Elaine Langone Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The top floor of the Elaine Langone Center is recognized by students for its atmosphere of hard work and proximity to snacks.
cards.source_title: Bucknell's best study spots - The Bucknellian
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible student center space; hours vary by semester.

cards.title: The Niche
cards.subtitle: Behind 7th Street Cafe
cards.notes: Tucked away behind the 7th Street Cafe, this quiet spot offers a more secluded environment than the main cafe while keeping coffee within reach.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, semi-secluded study area connected to the 7th Street Cafe and Craft Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Niche is described as a quiet study spot and well-kept secret located behind the 7th Street Cafe.
cards.access_notes: Accessible through the 7th Street Cafe; check cafe hours for entry.

cards.title: Humanities Library
cards.subtitle: Hildreth-Mirza Hall
cards.notes: Study in a beautifully restored hall that serves as the home for the humanities. Features a dedicated library and collaborative workspaces.
cards.short_summary: A specialized library and research space within the renovated Hildreth-Mirza Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Hildreth-Mirza Hall houses a humanities library and collaborative workspaces within the Humanities Center.
cards.access_notes: Open to students; the building also features a digital editing studio and conference rooms.

cards.title: Mildred Martin Library
cards.subtitle: Bucknell Hall
cards.notes: Find a cozy, welcoming environment in this mini-library. It features stacks of contemporary poetry and comfortable lounge seating.
cards.short_summary: A small, welcoming library and lounge located inside the historic Bucknell Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mildred Martin Library and Lounge inside Bucknell Hall is noted as a comfortable spot for reading poetry.
cards.source_title: Secret study spots on campus - The Bucknellian
cards.access_notes: Located in the center of Bucknell Hall; accessible during building hours.

cards.title: 24-Hour Study Lounge
cards.subtitle: Bertrand Library, Level 1
cards.notes: Utilize this renovated space for late-night sessions. It provides round-the-clock access to study tables and computer workstations.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated study area within Bertrand Library that remains open 24 hours a day for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Bertrand Library offers a variety of study spaces, including a newly renovated 24-hour study lounge.
cards.access_notes: Accessible 24/7 with a valid Bucknell ID card.
